title: windows.auditeventpolicysubcategories
$comment: Proposed documentation integration only. These definitions annotate fields; they add no validation restrictions.

x-doc-contract.note: Native collection boundaries, field multiplicity, missing values and error propagation are not established by field descriptions. Legacy source documentation is not a native execution contract.

credential_validation.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced during the validation of a user's logon credentials.

kerberos_authentication_service.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by Kerberos authentication ticket-granting requests.

kerberos_service_ticket_operations.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by Kerberos service ticket requests.

other_account_logon_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to user accounts that are not covered by other events in the Account Logon category.

application_group_management.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to application groups.

computer_account_management.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to computer accounts.

distribution_group_management.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to distribution groups.

other_account_management_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by other user account changes that are not covered by other events in the Account Management category.

security_group_management.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to security groups.

user_account_management.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to user accounts.

dpapi_activity.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when requests are made to the Data Protection application interface.

process_creation.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when a process is created or starts.

process_termination.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when a process ends.

rpc_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by inbound remote procedure call connections.

directory_service_access.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when an Active Directory Domain Services object is accessed.

directory_service_changes.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when changes are made to Active Directory Domain Services objects.

directory_service_replication.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when two Active Directory Domain Services domain controllers are replicated.

detailed_directory_service_replication.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by detailed Active Directory Domain Services replication between domain controllers.

account_lockout.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by a failed attempt to log onto a locked out account.

ipsec_extended_mode.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by Internet Key Exchange and Authenticated Internet protocol during Extended Mode negotiations.

ipsec_main_mode.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by Internet Key Exchange and Authenticated Internet protocol during Main Mode negotiations.

ipsec_quick_mode.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by Internet Key Exchange and Authenticated Internet protocol during Quick Mode negotiations.

logoff.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by closing a logon session.

logon.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by attempts to log onto a user account.

network_policy_server.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by RADIUS and Network Access Protection user access requests.

other_logon_logoff_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by other logon/logoff based events that are not covered in the Logon/Logoff category.

special_logon.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by special logons.

logon_claims.description: Audit-policy setting for user and device claims information in the user's logon token.

application_generated.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by applications that use the Windows Auditing API.

certification_services.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by operations on Active Directory Certificate Services.

detailed_file_share.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by attempts to access files and folders on a shared folder.

file_share.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by attempts to access a shared folder.

file_system.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced user attempts to access file system objects.

filtering_platform_connection.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by connections that are allowed or blocked by Windows Filtering Platform.

filtering_platform_packet_drop.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by packets that are dropped by Windows Filtering Platform.

handle_manipulation.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced when a handle is opened or closed.

kernel_object.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by attempts to access the system kernel.

other_object_access_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by the management of Task Scheduler jobs or COM+ objects.

registry.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by attempts to access registry objects.

sam.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by attempts to access Security Accounts Manager objects.

removable_storage.description: Audit-policy setting for events that indicate file object access attemps to removable storage.

central_access_policy_staging.description: Audit-policy setting for events that indicate permission granted or denied by a proposed policy differs from the current central access policy on an object.

audit_policy_change.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes in security audit policy settings.

authentication_policy_change.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to the authentication policy.

authorization_policy_change.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to the authorization policy.

filtering_platform_policy_change.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to the Windows Filtering Platform.

mpssvc_rule_level_policy_change.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes to policy rules used by the Windows Firewall.

other_policy_change_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by other security policy changes that are not covered other events in the Policy Change category.

non_sensitive_privilege_use.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by the use of non-sensitive privileges.

other_privilege_use_events.description: Audit-policy setting for other privilege-use events.

sensitive_privilege_use.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by the use of sensitive privileges.

ipsec_driver.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by the IPsec filter driver.

other_system_events.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by the startup and shutdown, security policy processing, and cryptography key file and migration operations of the Windows Firewall.

security_state_change.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by changes in the security state.

security_system_extension.description: Audit-policy setting for the events produced by the security system extensions or services.

system_integrity.description: Audit-policy setting for the events that indicate that the integrity security subsystem has been violated.

group_membership.description: Audit-policy setting for the group membership of a token for an associated log on.

pnp_activity.description: Audit-policy setting for events generated by plug and play (PNP).

user_device_claims.description: Audit-policy setting for the user and device claims that are present in the token of an associated logon.

audit_detailedtracking_tokenrightadjuste.description: Audit-policy setting for when token privileges are enabled or disabled for a specific account’s token.
